This is because consuming more calories than needed to clear the plate can lead to an overall increase in daily caloric intake, potentially contributing to weight accumulation.

In other words, having a strong tendency to clear one's plate when eating might indicate that someone is likely to consume more food than necessary, thereby increasing their risk of becoming overweight or obese.
